purpose: Phase-5D TRANSLATION MACHINERY registry. Schematic vocabularies + runtime dynamics for the translation engine (ribosome recruitment, initiation, elongation, termination, folding, maturation, turnover). Consumed READ-ONLY by translationEngine.js. All timing is SCHEMATIC simulation time, NOT a validated biological timescale; no translation rate, ribosome count, amino-acid length, initiation probability, folding time, or degradation constant is a measured value. No parameter is hard-coded in the engine.
timing_disclaimer: Translation timing is schematic and is not a validated biological timescale. Simulation units, not biological seconds.
polysome_note: The engine supports N ribosomes per mRNA (independent progress), but the DEFAULT profile uses one schematic ribosome per active mRNA. Polysome counts / ribosome density / inter-ribosome spacing are NOT invented; enabling >1 is a schematic architectural option only.

capacity_model.signal_node_linked_note: A profile MAY tie global capacity to an upstream signal node (e.g. mTOR suppression -> reduced capacity) ONLY when its evidence record permits it, labelled LITERATURE_DERIVED_PREDICTION or MECHANISTIC_PREDICTION. This is NOT applied automatically to every profile.
